versions.changelog: Document API endpoints (kbaas.do-ai.run, inference.do-ai.run) and add credential scoping guidance
Fix prompt injection: separate user query from system instructions using proper message roles
Fix VirusTotal findings: declare GRADIENT_API_KEY in requires.env, add requires.pip for requests and boto3 dependencies, add per-skill requirements.txt
Initial release: DO Spaces uploads, Knowledge Base CRUD, data source management, semantic/hybrid search, and RAG-enhanced queries.
